description: Performance testing script for various JSON schema validation libraries, including fastjsonschema, jsonschema, validictory, jsonspec, with schema definitions, test data, and timing functions.

methods.name: fast_compiled
methods.description: Validates data using pre-compiled fastjsonschema validator.

methods.name: fast_not_compiled
methods.description: Compiles schema and validates data without caching.

methods.name: fast_compiled_without_exc
methods.description: Validates data with fastjsonschema validator configured to suppress detailed exceptions.

methods.name: jsonschema_compiled
methods.description: Validates data using jsonschema validator object.

methods.name: fast_file
methods.description: Validates data using a dynamically imported validation module generated from schema.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Runs timing tests for specified validation functions with valid or invalid data sets.
